market_view: VIX fell to 15.8 but the 10-year yield sits at a high of 4.98% and WTI is about $100 after a 23% 20-day rise. Monday brings an AI-pacing selloff in chips and memory; no other broad shock.

oil_gas.catalyst: none (Benzinga: 'Exxon Sees the US Supplying Nearly a Third of the World's LNG by 2030' is a long-dated talk, XOM already +2% on it)
oil_gas.reasoning: Oil spike is priced and XOM already moved on the LNG remark. No XOM-specific one-sided near-term catalyst; Chevron headlines are not XOM news.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is below its 200-day average, yields at a high are a headwind, and NEM headlines are Zacks-style commentary ('lower production, higher costs and falling estimates'). No guidance event.

chips.catalyst: none (Yahoo: 'Chip Stocks Tumble as AI Pacing Call Reaches Beyond Memory' is a sentiment shock, not a company or policy change)
chips.reasoning: A weekend essay on slowing AI sent chips down; a rebound is a guess, and a further slide is equally plausible. No NVDA demand or export news.

pharma.catalyst: none (Yahoo: 'Eli Lilly Fell Like a Rock Over the Last Month: This Big Bank Expects 45% Returns' is an analyst opinion)
pharma.reasoning: No LLY trial, approval or pricing news. A bank target and the Novo rebrand are not one-sided catalysts; the dip is already known.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none (SeekingAlpha: 'Freeport-McMoRan: Recovering From Grasberg Drives Potential 10% FCF Yield' is a blog thesis)
copper_uranium.reasoning: No FCX guidance, supply outage or China data in the headlines. Copper is flat to slightly down; the Grasberg recovery is known.

would_change_my_mind: A named, one-sided leader event: FCX or NEM guidance change, an LLY approval or trial result, an NVDA demand or export-rule headline, or XOM-specific supply or M&A news.

handoff.what_changed: A weekend call from AI CEOs for slower AI development hit chip and memory stocks Monday (Intel -7%, AMD -6%, NVDA lower). Oil was down about 2.4% on Friday but still near $100, and XOM gained about 2% on an LNG supply comment. The 10-year yield rose to 4.98%, a new high.

oil_gas.why: Oil spike is priced and XOM's LNG remark is long-dated, not a one-sided catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Yield at a high and gold below its 200-day average; no NEM guidance news.

chips.why: AI-pacing selloff is a sentiment shock with no named NVDA catalyst; rebound is a guess.

pharma.why: No LLY trial, approval or pricing news; only an analyst target.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX guidance or supply news; copper flat and Grasberg recovery already known.
